title: When in Our Music God is Glorified
lyrics: Verse 1:
[G]When in our [D]music [Am]God [D]is [G]glorified,
[D]And [Em]adoration [G]leaves [A7]no [D]room [A7]for [D]pride,
[Dm]It [G]is [G7]as [C]though the [Am]whole [D7]creation [G]cried
Am D7 G C Dsus D7
Al-le-lu- ia!
Verse 2:
When in our music God is glorified,
And adoration leaves no room for pride,
It is as though the whole creation cried
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Verse 3:
How oft, in making music, we have found
A new dimension in the world of sound,
As worship moved us to a more profound
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Verse 4:
And did not Jesus sing a psalm that night
When utmost evil strove against the light?
Then let us sing for whom He won the fight
Alleluia! Alleluia!
Verse 5:
Let every instrument be used for praise;
Let all rejoice who have a voice to raise;
And may God give us faith to sing always
Alleluia! Alleluia!
